Resources

Tools, databases, and references used throughout the course.

Tools used in the activities

Tool Used for
NCBI Datasets Downloading genome assemblies by accession
FastANI Average nucleotide identity (ANI) between genomes
GAMBIT Species identification against a curated reference database
ShigaPass Distinguishing Shigella, enteroinvasive E. coli, and other E. coli, and predicting Shigella serotypes
mlst Multilocus sequence typing from assemblies
Floc Iterative k-mer clustering for genomic surveillance
LABEL Influenza segment, subtype, and clade assignment
micromamba Installing the tools into self-contained environments

Databases and nomenclature

  • NCBI Pathogen Detection: genomic surveillance data and SNP clusters for foodborne and healthcare-associated pathogens
  • PubMLST: MLST schemes and allele databases for many species
  • EnteroBase: genomes and typing schemes for Escherichia, Salmonella, and related genera
  • ICTV: official virus taxonomy

Getting comfortable with the command line

  • The Unix Shell from Software Carpentry
  • Windows Subsystem for Linux for running Linux tools on Windows
